description: PHP is a popular general-purpose scripting language that is especially suited to web development.

audience_guidance.student: PHP powers many websites. Older PHP code often mixes data and commands, leading to easily hackable sites.
audience_guidance.developer: Always use PDO with prepared statements. Disable dangerous functions like exec() and passthru() in php.ini.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Test for Local File Inclusion (LFI) in URL parameters (e.g., ?page=../../etc/passwd). Look for exposed phpinfo() pages.
audience_guidance.pentester: Search for exposed phpinfo.php. Test file upload forms for unrestricted PHP script uploads (.php, .phtml).
audience_guidance.security_team: Ensure servers are running supported PHP versions (8.x). Audit legacy codebases for unparameterized SQL queries.
